name: Thai Green Chicken Curry

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.original: 600 g chicken thighs, cut into 3 cm pieces

ingredients.name: gluten-free Thai green curry paste
ingredients.original: 3 tbsp (60 g) gluten-free Thai green curry paste

ingredients.name: green beans
ingredients.original: 150 g green beans, trimmed and halved

steps: Rinse the jasmine rice, then combine with 500 ml water in a saucepan. Bring to the boil, cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. Rest off the heat, covered, until serving.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large deep frying pan over high heat. Brown the chicken thigh pieces in two batches, then set aside on a plate.
Add the onion wedges and carrot to the same pan and cook for 3 minutes until starting to soften.
Return the chicken to the pan, add the gluten-free Thai green curry paste and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the coconut milk, fish sauce and brown sugar, scraping up anything stuck to the base of the pan, and bring to a simmer.
Add the capsicum, zucchini and green beans. Simmer, uncovered, for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are just tender.
Stir in the lime juice, then taste and add a pinch of salt if needed.
Fluff the rice and serve the curry over it, scattered with the basil leaves.
